# Hollowblade

The Hollowed are Rift-touched humans. Too much exposure to the Rift changes you — you start seeing things that aren't there, or things that ARE there but shouldn't be visible. Most people fear the Hollowed. Some learn from them.

A Hollowblade is a rogue who trained among the Hollowed and absorbed just enough Rift energy to blur the edges of their own existence — without losing themselves to it. They flicker. They vanish. They see what the Rift reveals. And when they strike, the Rift stuns their target for just long enough.

## Hollow Step

*3rd-level Hollowblade feature*

You've learned to briefly phase into the Veil — not fully, not dangerously, just enough. As a bonus action, you can become invisible until the end of your current turn or until you make an attack or force a saving throw, whichever comes first.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

To anyone watching, you're there — then you're not — then you're somewhere else entirely.

## Rift-Touched Strike

*9th-level Hollowblade feature*

When you deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can channel a trace of Rift energy through the blade. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) or be unable to take reactions until the start of your next turn.

The Rift doesn't knock them out. It just makes them miss a beat — and a beat is all you need.

## Veil Reflexes

*13th-level Hollowblade feature*

Your body has learned to phase before your mind realizes there's danger. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to activate Hollow Step. This does not consume a use of the feature — you slip through the Veil on instinct. If Hollow Step is expended, you gain one free use for this activation.

Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

## Hollow's Truth

*17th-level Hollowblade feature*

You have absorbed enough Rift energy to enter the perception state of a true Hollowed — temporarily, and on your terms. Once per long rest, you can use an action to open your senses fully to the Rift for 1 minute.

While in this state, you can see invisible creatures, ethereal creatures, and creatures currently phased or displaced. You have advantage on all Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Insight) checks. The Rift shows you everything — every lie, every hidden thing, every crack in the veil that separates what's real from what's hiding.

Your eyes glow faintly violet while this state is active. The Hollowed would recognize you as one of their own — or close enough.
